title: Crowd
category: Brand Identity • Brand Guidelines • Logo Design
description: Crowd is a real estate and construction company in Egypt built around the idea of people coming together to shape the future of urban living. I created its logo and brand book, translating that idea of collective strength into a mark and a visual system that feel solid and trustworthy, yet warm and human.
challenge: A construction brand usually leans on heavy, corporate imagery. Crowd needed to feel dependable enough for people making one of the biggest investments of their lives, while also expressing something different: a company where customers and employees are part of something bigger. The identity had to carry that collaborative spirit without losing the credibility the industry demands.
solution: I built the logo from three simple ideas: the letter C, a house, and a person. Together they form a single mark in which a human figure sits at the heart of the home, so the people behind the buildings are always visible. The identity is anchored by a confident palette of Nile Blue for trust and stability, paired with a bright blue and an orangey yellow for optimism and energy, set in Milliard for a clean, modern voice. I then extended the mark into a repeating pattern and documented everything in a brand book covering the brand principles, manifesto and main claim, followed by logo usage, colour and typography rules.
results: Crowd now has a complete and ready-to-use brand foundation: a distinctive logo with full-colour and single-colour versions, a defined palette, a typography choice, a supporting pattern, and a brand book that sets out its positioning and how to apply the identity consistently as the company grows.
